its own comment covers this case — a pre-free callee, crow is the fresh
row cell — and the proof is in the artifact, since main's row on the
repro reads () -> Int with B. The callback's effect reaches the caller.

What is broken, from two projections of one file: run's published type
is (f: () -> t with r34983) -> t with r34981. The authored with Pure is
not in it. The body's inferred row is a free var, the declared row
neither refuses against it nor binds it, and the declaration is dropped
from the published scheme. The repro compiles because there is no Pure
left to violate.

The contrast that pins it: fn direct() with OnlyA = opb() refuses with
E_EffectMismatch: A vs B. Same machinery, same check; the only
difference is a concrete body row instead of a free one. A declared row
is enforced against concrete rows and vacuous against a free var.

at publication or the check admits a free var — and the two call for

three retractions this arc already paid for. The next probe instruments

mentl/301076c:
The higher-order-effect trap bisected to a CLASS: a polymorphic relationship the
graph should carry as a live edge, re-derived instead as copied free variables that
lose their link. This drafts the ultimate form of that relationship and every
subsystem it touches.

Thesis: polymorphism (type AND effect) is not a quantified free variable — it is a
FLOW EDGE in the inference graph (`this row/type flows from that one`), read live by
the cursor (= union-find find), Reason on the edge. generalize / instantiate /
subst_ty / subst_row / free_in / the HandlerKind residual accumulator / the dual
derive_ev_slots vs compute_ev_index re-derivation / the silent slot-0 fallback ALL
dissolve into "draw the edge, read it live." The graph IS the substitution.

Full design: 3 edge kinds (Eq/Flow/Block) + instance frames for let-poly without
copying; one read (project); operations restated as edge-drawing; 11 touched
subsystems each upgraded onto the same edges (types, effects algebra, ev-layout,
graph, Reason/Why, refinement, ownership, cursor, query, decidability, seed);
let-poly-without-copying risk register; the dispatch gradient falling out; and a
5-step incremental path where Step 1 (residual-as-live-edge + fatal fallback) closes
L1 and is a step IN the model's direction, not a bookkeeping patch.

Verified the way Mentl verifies everything: by simulation + the higher-order-effect
ladder + census, never by "it compiled." Floor of the Graph+HM-live primitive.
